title: Cover — page cover image picker (gallery · upload · link · Unsplash · reposition)
description: Full Notion-style page cover feature, lifted from notion-page-clone and made portable. CoverBanner renders the cover band (colour / gradient / texture / uploaded / linked / Unsplash image) with hover controls to Change, Reposition (drag the vertical focal point), or Remove. AddCoverButton is the no-cover affordance. CoverPicker is the 4-tab chooser: Gallery (12 colours + 8 gradients + Notion textures), Upload (drag/click, ≤8MB), Link (paste any https image URL), Unsplash (bundled curated landscapes + live search). The slice imports no other slice and no backend — the upload backend and Unsplash search are INJECTED as props (onUpload + searchUnsplash), so it drops into any app: wire onUpload to the `files` slice and searchUnsplash to a server route (unsplashSearchVia('/api/unsplash')) that holds UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY server-side. Cover values are CoverData ({ type, value, positionY?, metadata? }); parseCover normalizes legacy raw-string covers. coverStyle builds the CSS focal-point background.
